transcript: Speaker A: यार वो इंग्लिश कोचिंग वाले हज़ारों रुपये ऐंठ लेते हैं। ऊपर से रोज़ जाने-आने का झंझट अलग। [Friend, those English coaching centers squeeze thousands of rupees. on_screen_text: SpeakEasy AI, Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy, Install Now, GET IT ON Google Play
summary: A split-screen dialogue contrasts expensive, embarrassing offline English classes with the SpeakEasy app. The app is presented as a 24/7, judgment-free, and highly affordable alternative. It ends with a call to download the app on Google Play.
